"""
INT. LIGHTHOUSE - WATCH ROOM - MORNING

Early light fills the watch room. Elena sits across from Marcus, a YELLOW LEGAL PAD open on her knee. She taps her pen.

Marcus sets a large BLACK LOGBOOK on the desk between them.

MARCUS
This covers 1910 to 1940. Most of what you would find useful is in here.

Elena pages through it, making notes on her yellow legal pad.

ELENA

ELENA (CONT'D)

MARCUS

No. I've never taken to hot drinks. Never have. You go ahead.

She pours a cup and studies him over the rim.
